Navada men kriket khelne ke vivad ne liya khuni rup, 17 varshiy aadity ki pit-pitkar hatya ka aarop, ilake men dahshat aur sanasni
Patna PMCH men ilaj ke dauran kishor ne tora dam, shav pahunchte hi ghar men machi chikh-pukar, parijnon ne chacha aur chachere bhaee samet panch logon par lagaya marpit ka aarop
Nagar thana kshetr ke purani jel rod ki ghatna, pulis ne mauke par pahunchkar shuru ki janch, parijnon ka bayan darj kar har pahlu ko khangal rahi pulis
